Modernize SpotifyAdapter with official Spotify Web API client credentials (SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID / SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET) and sp_dc/sp_key cookie fallback, high-fidelity metadata resolution, and robust multi-source streaming bridge (SoundCloud/YouTube) with clean doctor checks.

Prioritize YouTube Music / Topic official audio and eliminate incorrect fuzzy matches from SoundCloud radio/podcast streams.
